# Review

## Outcome

**Request Changes**

## Evidence

- Targeted checks passed: `cargo test -p tank_core low_do_high_demand_yields_shallow_penetration`, `cargo test -p tank_core zone_habitat_integration_oxic_maps_to_surface_suboxic_maps_to_deep`, and `cargo test -p tank_core save_load_roundtrip_preserves_o2_penetration_depth`.
- An ad hoc repro against the built crate printed `zero_do_penetration=3.000000 depth=3.000000` after setting water-column DO to 0 and calling `step_substrate_zones`, so the current implementation marks an anoxic bed as fully oxic.
- An ad hoc two-layer repro printed `first_layer_penetration=0.900700` and `total_oxic_depth_across_stack=1.801401`, showing the same penetration depth is applied independently to each layer and overcounts oxic depth across the stack.
- `rg -n "oxic_.*nutrient|suboxic_.*nutrient|nutrient availability" crates/tank_core/src/types crates/tank_core/src/systems` found no per-zone nutrient availability API.

## Findings and Gaps

- High: [substrate.rs](/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/systems/substrate.rs#L45) returns full-depth penetration when `do_mg_per_cm3 <= 0.0`, and [substrate.rs](/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/types/substrate.rs#L98) treats any `o2_penetration_depth_cm <= 0.0` as 'legacy/uncomputed'. A physically valid 0 cm penetration therefore cannot be represented; zero-DO conditions collapse to fully oxic substrate instead of fully suboxic substrate.
- High: [step_substrate_zones](/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/systems/substrate.rs#L23) computes the same penetration depth independently for every layer, while [oxic_depth_cm](/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/types/substrate.rs#L110) and [compute_substrate_surface](/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs#L203) sum those per-layer oxic slices. That violates the bead's single-boundary definition for stacked layers and overstates oxic volume/area in multi-layer beds.
- Medium: [substrate.rs](/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/types/substrate.rs#L120) adds pore-volume and colonizable-area helpers, but the promised per-zone nutrient-availability API is still missing. Reviewer-requested edge-case coverage for zero penetration, shallow-substrate, and stacked-layer behavior is also absent, which is why the two correctness bugs above are not caught by tests.

## Follow-up and Amendments

- Represent 'not yet computed' separately from a valid 0 cm penetration, and make the diffusion calculation return 0 cm when water-column DO is 0 or negative. Add a regression test that anoxic water yields zero oxic depth and positive suboxic volume.
- Rework zone slicing to use one cumulative penetration boundary across the entire substrate stack, then derive each layer's oxic/suboxic contribution from its top/bottom depths before habitat-area and pore-volume aggregation. Add a two-layer regression test where only the upper layer is partially oxic and the lower layer is fully suboxic.
- Add the canonical per-zone nutrient-availability accessors needed by the downstream denitrification/root-zone beads, and cover the remaining requested cases such as shallow substrate having no deep zone and zone depths summing to total depth.
- Because persisted state changed, bump [save.rs](/home/master/p/tank-simulation/crates/tank_core/src/save.rs#L14) `SCHEMA_VERSION` and append the corresponding no-op migration so legacy and post-change saves are distinguishable under the repo's save contract.
